doc: Active play F3 Free décor placement (docs/gdd/ACTIVE_DECOR.md). Rules and tuning for edit mode, validity, soft snapping, derived spots, storage, undo, migration from spots.json decor_anchors, and budgets. Positions are normalized to the 1080x1920 bottom-anchored play frame (x right, y down; 1.0 x = 360 dp, 1.0 y = 640 dp; x may leave [0, 1] into the pan wings). Distances in dp, durations in ms unless _s. Strings in i18n/staging_decor.csv until merged. Placement never changes attraction, snug or dew (counts stay owned copies), so tools/sim/economy_sim.py is untouched.

edge_autopan.note: Only while a piece is held by a drag. Speed grows with depth into the zone; it never pans past the WorldPan rest bounds.

hit.note: Play mode: pinwheel and lantern keep PRIO_DECOR 3 (64 dp hit, 20 dp core). Cairn stacks, toadstools and stream stones become long-press-only targets at PRIO_STILL 1 (tap = a small wobble + S01; never outranks a bed, prop or mossling; a stone beats the brook only through its core). Edit mode: only pieces (prio 8, +1 for the selected one) and the ground are world targets.

area.ground_top_note: The hollow's walkable rim (GDD 2.2: ridge 0.30, rim 0.42; the hill crest carries pinwheels at 0.372). Env Artist to confirm against the meadow mask, especially in the wings (x < 0 and x > 1).
area.ground_bottom_note: tend zone bottom (spots.json zones). Nothing is placed under the dock; the brook below 0.785 stays decorative.

water.note: Distance is to the polyline in dp. Water half width = water_width x 640 / 2 = 11.5 dp.

clearances.spot_clear_note: Centre of an always-on spot to the piece footprint edge. Gated spots (requires_item) are derived from clusters (derived_spots) and are not exclusions.

bed_soil.note: The planted soil ellipse, not the 90 x 63 dp hit rect: lanterns may stand at a bed's lower edge as today; the bed's core still wins its taps (GDD 2.5).

nest.note: Nests are friends' homes and look lovely among décor (the puddlewump nest sits on the stepping stones), so they are not area exclusions: a dropped piece's foot stays 12 dp from a built nest's centre so the nest stays visible and tappable. A nest built later never moves a piece; RetentionRules may shift the nest up to 24 dp if a footprint covers its centre (contract).

sign_anchors.note: Sign anchors (mysteries.json) never block décor; a sign whose anchor is covered by a footprint + gap_dp picks its next free anchor of the same type (contract for RetentionRules).

props.note: trunk foot only; Env Artist to confirm

clearances.hard_note: Hard exclusions (hard: true props, the tea nook) also apply to migrated (legacy) pieces: a legacy piece inside one is nudged on load (today: pinwheels #4 and #8 under the F2 tea nook). Every other rule applies to new drops only; legacy positions are kept even where they sit closer than these numbers (e.g. stone #9 against the spring rock, pinwheel #7 beside the toadstool ring).
clearances.props_note: Footprint ellipses on the ground: centre = prop centre + cy_dp down (props.json x/y are visual centres; the foot is lower). Tappable props (basket, mailbox) use their 64 dp hit circle with gap 0: a piece's foot may touch the hit ring, its tap core never enters it.

leaf_pinwheel.rot_note: variant 1 swaps pinwheel_a / pinwheel_b blades (the back face)

pebble_cairn.rot_note: a turn re-seeds the pebble offsets (+-4 px) and tilts (+-5 deg); the stack stays balanced

stream_stones.riffle: BrookLayer.set_stone(key, foot, r) at the new foot

firefly_lantern.rot_note: the crook faces left or right

wind_chime.rail_note: Tubes hang from the willow branch (a prop); they keep their anchors. Edit mode shows them without a lift target. Later hang points (stump branch, lantern crook) are an open question (ACTIVE_DECOR.md Q2).

snap.bank_line_note: the brook polyline moved 22 dp up (the far bank, where the lanterns stand today)

beautify.face_cluster_note: a dropped pinwheel or lantern takes the rotation step most common in its cluster unless the player turned it in this session
beautify.odd_cluster_note: 05 section 4 odd-cluster rule lives in the sockets (rings of 8 and lines), never as a message

derived_spots.rule: The spot exists while owned copies >= requires_min (as today). Its position is taken from the largest placed cluster (cluster_link_dp linkage) holding >= min pieces; else from all placed pieces of the set; else its authored spots.json position. A derived position that breaks a hard exclusion or sits within 20 dp of another spot moves along the offset direction in 4 dp steps (max 24 dp), else uses the authored position.

attraction.count_note: requires / likes_items / snug / spot gating all count owned copies, placed or tucked away (unchanged from MVP; sim parity). Only fx (glow, riffles, ring motes, pool lights) and the F1 decor_near check use placed pieces.

brain_flavour.note: creature brain only (not the sim): a friend that likes a set wanders and rests beside its pieces a little more often

auto_place.when: a new copy is bought, or Find a spot is tapped

rules: copy n of each set takes anchors[n] verbatim (rot 0, placed)
lantern jitter (DecorLayer LANTERN_JITTER_PX, seeded by hash(lantern, n)) is baked into x so nothing moves on screen
pebble_cairn: all copies form one stack at anchors[0], in copy order
wind_chime: copies stay on their rail anchors (movable false)
hard exclusions (props, tea nook) nudge a piece by snap.invalid_drop.nudge_search_dp; every other rule is grandfathered
pieces owned but missing from decor_layout (a later purchase on an older build) are auto_placed on load
migration.note: One content-aware Active Play migration step (ActiveRules.migrate_v1, GDD 14.9) runs once when active_v < 1, after RetentionRules.migrate_v1: decor_layout from the anchors, tea_unlocked, nothing else changes.

draw.merge_note: Static pieces (cairn stacks, toadstools, stones, lanterns) merge into one stamp per (set, y band of 16 dp) for y-sort; if the décor total would pass the cap, the nearest bands of a set merge. The held piece draws on its own stamp (+1) and re-merges on settle.

audio.note: Cue ids assigned centrally by the lead pass (GDD 14.8): S26-S27 Active F1, S28-S34 Active F2, S35-S38 Active F3. An invalid spot never sounds; S11 plays only on a disabled button (Undo with nothing to undo).

haptics.note: Full mode; Subtle mode keeps only settle
